title: 2 gaming PCs + an M4 Pro MacBook over Ethernet + 2 iPhone 17 Pro Maxes over USB-C: Qwen3.8 Flash Next at 37-39 tok/s at 60k context (262k layout in the works)
hook_text: Run Qwen3.8 on your home setup
script:
Qwen3.8 Flash Next is officially out with a massive 262 thousand token context window.
This new model from Alibaba Cloud is designed for high-efficiency local deployment.
The architecture allows for impressive throughput even on varied consumer hardware configurations.
Users are finding that Qwen3.8 maintains speed while processing massive documents.
This capacity makes it one of the most capable models for long-form memory tasks.
It outperforms previous generations in handling complex, multi-step instructions without data loss.
